dedupe_keys.name: global gridded industrial water use dataset 0 5 degree 2000 to 2015

description: This dataset estimates the spatial distribution of industrial water use worldwide on a 0.5 degree grid for 2000 to 2015. It was produced with a random forest regression model, and the deposit contains the input datasets, the output grids and the Python code used to prepare them, each folder explained in a README file. Two figshare deposits exist: an earlier one titled "Industrial water use spatial dataset" (15 November 2023, a RAR archive of about 144 MB) and "Global industrial water use dataset from 2000 to 2015" (1 July 2024, a ZIP archive of about 204 MB with data and code). Both are free under CC BY 4.0; the author names are not shown on the API pages read. Caveats: values are model estimates, not reported withdrawals, the half-degree grid is coarse for single plants, the period ends in 2015, and the difference between the two deposits is not explained on the pages read. For simulation it gives a consistent global layer of industrial water demand, useful to allocate industrial withdrawals in water supply and drought models and to see where industry competes with cities and farms for water. Related catalogue records include the high-resolution industrial water use dataset for China, the USGS industrial water use estimates for 2020 and the semiconductor water withdrawals dataset.
